Latin word

Age!

imperative of agō used as a particle, before another imperative; also to several people, beside agite

come on! go on!

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Aul. 40: Exī, inquam. age exī.; Verg. G. 1.63: ergō age
